text:
Elena (CS): flagging MediNote onboarding - sudden p95 tail on /v1/chat up from ~600ms to ~1150ms in last 36h. renewal touchpoint in 6 days. thinking a low-risk perf experiment: switch normal traffic to compact-llama-4B-int8 with routing-based spillover to gpu-13B for long docs. want to run a short canary + offline QA on the clinician_summary_suite.

Tomas (Solutions): can we get baseline p50/p95 and avg token length? also curious about cost delta estimates for int8 vs float16.

Elena (CS): p50 280ms, p95 1150ms, avg payload ~160 tokens (many multi-section notes). rough cost: compact-4B-int8 expects ~40-55% token cost reduction vs gpu-13B at current serving profiles.

Ike (SRE): any traffic pattern changes? cache warmups? increased concurrency?

Elena (CS): noticed spikes align with nightly batch imports around 02:30 UTC. those hits blow past prefix cache and cause cold KV chain for 2-3 mins.

Tomas (Solutions): proposed plan: 1) run offline evaluation against clinician_summary_suite (metrics: ROUGE, F1 on named-entities, hallucination flag rate); 2) create routing rule: prefer compact-llama-4B-int8 for /v1/chat unless request.headers["x-long-context"]=="true"; 3) canary 15% for 24h; 4) auto-rollback if user-feedback rate >1.5% in 30m or hallucination rate >1% by automated eval.

Elena (CS): +1. Priya (Customer) - would you be comfortable enabling the feedback widget during the canary so clinicians can flag issues?

Priya (Customer): yes please, we want an explicit toggle and a short survey on any flagged output (reason: missing follow-up, incorrect med, other). auto-rollback sounds good.

Ike (SRE): will provision canary and add rollback action. setting thresholds: feedback_rate_threshold=0.015, sample_eval_window=30m. also will rate-limit batch-imports to reduce cold pressure while we test.

Tomas (Solutions): routing snippet for Redwood Console (pseudo-json):
```json
{
  "rules": [
    {"name":"compact-pref","match":"path==\"/v1/chat\" && headers.x-long-context!=\"true\"","prefer":"compact-llama-4B-int8","fallback":"gpu-13B","canary_percent":15,"window":"15m"}
  ]
}
```

Elena (CS): adding follow-ups: @Tomas run offline eval and produce a one-pager with sample diffs; @Ike run canary infra and wire auto-rollback; @Priya enable feedback + short survey; i'll add the remediation note to the renewal brief.

canary-bot: Canary job created: canary-8123456789. Observability: https://console.redwood/example/canary/canary-8123456789

Ike (SRE): canary live. initial metrics streaming: canary group p95=520ms, baseline p95=1120ms. sampling 30 clinician-style requests for quick QA: phrasing changes in 6/30 (cosmetic), no incorrect medication mentions.

Tomas (Solutions): offline eval (clinician_summary_suite) running. quick math: p95 reduction ~53%, estimated token-cost reduction ~48% for traffic that stays on compact. if quality delta (entity F1) <2% we'll recommend ramp to 50% over 24h.

Priya (Customer): clinicians enabled feedback. flagged 2 items so far (both style). added survey text on flagged outputs.

Ike (SRE): auto-rollback not triggered. feedback rate 0.6% in first 3h. streaming logs to Slack alert channel.

Tomas (Solutions): eval finished: ROUGE drop 1.2 pts, entity F1 delta -0.9%, hallucination automated check 0.2% (within threshold). attaching artifacts to renewal packet.

Elena (CS): great. renewal note: "Proactive perf mitigation executed: compact-int8 canary decreased p95 by ~50% with ~48% projected cost savings; quality checks within guardrails. recommended ramp plan in packet." I'll prepare a short slide for the renewal call.

Priya (Customer): this looks promising. appreciate the low-risk test and the quick feedback loop. please keep the UI feedback on during the ramp.

Ike (SRE): next step: ramp to 50% in 12h if no quality regressions; keep auto-rollback triggers and continue to throttle batch-imports during warm windows. closing loop here but will post updates as ramp progresses. :rocket:
